title: TimeSeries
description: A named time series used as input for anomaly detection, containing an ordered sequence of timestamped metric values.

id.description: Unique identifier for the time series.

name.description: Human-readable name for the time series.

description.description: Description of what this time series measures.
description.example: Average CPU utilization across production web cluster nodes.

metric.description: The metric being tracked in this series.

unit.description: Unit of measurement for the metric values.

granularity.description: Time granularity between data points (ISO 8601 duration).

seasonality.description: The dominant seasonality pattern observed in this series.

data_points.description: Ordered list of timestamped data points.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this time series was created.

dimensions.description: Dimensional metadata tags for this series.
